title: Minot AFB Emergency Dispatch Consoles
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND.FA4528  5 CONS
detail_text: The 5th Security Forces Squadron at Minot AFB has a requirement for the design, delivery, and installation of two (2) Law Enforcement Desk (LED) Dispatch Consoles and two (2) Fire and Emergency Services (F&ES) dispatch consoles. This presolicitation notice is not a request for quote or solicitation. Quotes will be solicited directly from vendors via email, in accordance with RFO 12.201-1(c)(2).
